new_failures.failed_witness: The first whole authorization-state projection truncated before EOF.
new_failures.recovery: Reread the exact current authorization state in bounded numbered windows through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure dense mutable-state documents and use conservative windows before projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined exact owner-manifest display truncated before every entry was attributable.
new_failures.recovery: Reread the missing deterministic windows and validate every entry computationally.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use compact manifest arithmetic plus bounded entry windows for large immutable manifests.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach producer was piped directly and raised EmptyPipeElement before any Git mutation.
new_failures.recovery: Materialized the foreach rows before JSON conversion.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

new_failures.failed_witness: A JavaScript orchestration wrapper contained invalid nested quoting and failed before launching its Git probes.
new_failures.recovery: Split the wrapper into short literal scalar commands.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer small independently attributable commands when PowerShell and JavaScript quoting interact.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first per-blob manifest replay yielded no attributable output within its wrapper window.
new_failures.recovery: Used one communicate-style git cat-file batch and compact exact parity output.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Batch immutable Git blobs with input and output handled by one completed subprocess.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first route-projection validator call guessed --projection instead of the installed --state argument.
new_failures.recovery: Read the installed help and reran only the projection validator with --state.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect exact installed subcommand help before composing mutable routing checks.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first projected-assignment call repeated the unsupported --projection argument.
new_failures.recovery: Applied the observed --state contract and reran only the bounded assignment lookup.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Reuse the validated installed argument contract across related subcommands.

new_failures.failed_witness: A prior-Orin template tree lookup used a one-character-wrong commit and returned not-a-tree.
new_failures.recovery: Read the exact prior Orin worktree head and used its literal owner-local template paths.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve a template head from its clean literal worktree before querying the object database.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first large title-block patch failed verification and changed no file.
new_failures.recovery: Applied sixty exact one-line title replacements through the same patch surface.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use small exact hunks for long independently replaceable list items.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first official-source patch retained one stale checked-date context and failed verification without a write.
new_failures.recovery: Inspected the exact materialized lines and changed only the corrected current source rows.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Re-read mechanically transformed context before applying a multi-entry semantic patch.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first complete reachable-proposal audit found no exact collision but quarantined two titles at or above the 0.78 token-Jaccard threshold.
new_failures.recovery: Projected only the two exact neighbour pairs and refined their semantic surfaces without changing hypotheses dispositions gates or threshold.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Run the complete reachable audit before freeze and preserve every quarantined first attempt.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first bounded neighbour projection reached its result but the host console could not encode a Māori macron under cp1252.
new_failures.recovery: Repeated only the projection with ASCII-safe JSON escaping.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use explicit UTF-8 or ASCII-safe escaping for bounded Windows console projections.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first post-build stale-label review found current schema identifiers still carrying the prior v684.v7 dotted version.
new_failures.recovery: Changed only current owner schema identifiers to v684.v7 and rebuilt the planning packet.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Search hyphenated underscored and dotted phase labels before staging a derived template.
